answer_1.quote: We propose to improve DRTS parsing by making use of the above structure information, modeling dependency-based syntax of the input sentences as well as the skeleton structure to enhance the baseline model of  using Graph Attention Network (GAT)

answer_2.quote: We adopt the COUNTER  tool to evaluate our final experimental results... we suggest three alternatives for evaluation particularly for development experiments: (1) BLEU: a standard BLEU  value is adopted as the metric to evaluate the resulting node sequence against the gold-standard output... (2) Skeleton: The bracket scoring method of constituent parsing is exploited to evaluate the skeleton performance... (3) Tuple: The F1-score of tuple-level matching is exploited to measure the DRU performance
